changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6f, item 3 (R48): wired the new Dispatcher.hooks.createTeam hook into TeamCollection.createFromRequest, which now runs it on a non-replay team.create request's own wire-shaped params before doing the repo/skill-source translation admin.sock and the Team MCP delegate used to each do for themselves; both callers now build one TeamCreateCommand and forward it unchanged.
